name: Improved Pattern Recognition
body:
You have expanded your pattern recognition skills beyond the regular ability of your race.

Prerequisite(s): Oc’cli; Wisdom 13+; pattern recognition ability.

Benefit(s): You can use your pattern recognition ability one additional time per day and you increase its bonus by 1.

Special: This feat can be taken once for each point of Wisdom bonus you have; its effects stack.
